name: Art Academy of Latvia
summary: Riga's national art academy: bachelor's degrees run in Latvian, and English is used only for exchange students and one joint master's.

handoff.label: Study options: exchange and joint master's

ib.text: No English-taught bachelor's degree. The main language of instruction is Latvian, so an IB Diploma alone does not open a degree place; English supervision is for exchange students.

notes: Incoming study in English is exchange study (Erasmus+ and similar) plus the joint master's in Service Design and Innovations; no bachelor's degree is offered in English.
